# W106: a queue has no producer or no consumer

**Severity:** warning · **Stage:** validator

Messages sent to a queue that nothing reads are lost, and a queue nothing writes to does nothing.

## Failing example

```saxl
system Shop
service Web
queue Jobs
Web ~> Jobs
```

## Fixed example

```saxl
system Shop
service Web
service Worker
queue Jobs
Web ~> Jobs
Jobs ~> Worker
```
